info.title: Traverse API
info.description: HTTP API for the Traverse graph database server.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: API key shown in the server startup banner (tvs_... format)

bearerAuth.description: Pass API key as Bearer token

loaded.description: Whether the database is currently loaded in memory

operation.description: Operation type (e.g. load, unload, save, drop)

result.description: Operation result on success (shape depends on operation)

taskId.description: Task ID to poll via GET /api/tasks/{id}

post.description: Ask Studio's Graph Assistant. The server answers with the model it is configured with (`ai_provider`: the Claude API or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and streams Server-Sent Events: `data: {"type":"text","text":...}` as the answer is written, `data: {"type":"error","error":...}` when it stops short, then `data: [DONE]`. 404 when no `ai_provider` is set (`/api/health` reports `features.ai`).

messages.description: The conversation so far, ending with the user's question.

metadata.description: Context for the assistant: graphSchema, queryDialect, currentQuery, lastQueryTimeMs, lastQueryPlanningMs, lastQueryExecutionMs, gdsAlgorithms.

400.description: Invalid conversation (empty, unknown role, empty message, or not ending with the user's)

get.description: Returns all database aliases with their target databases.

post.description: Creates a new alias pointing to an existing database.

400.description: Alias already exists or target database not found

put.description: Changes the target database for an existing alias.

400.description: Alias not found or target database not found

get.description: Returns all databases with their name and default flag.

post.description: Create a new empty in-memory database.
Loads a .tvdb file from the data directory into memory as a read-only database. Pass `?async=true` to run in the background.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: If true, returns 202 with a task ID instead of blocking

400.description: Invalid file path or database already exists

delete.description: Delete a database. Requires allow_drop_database to be enabled on the server. Pass `?async=true` to run in the background.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: If true, returns 202 with a task ID instead of blocking

post.description: Persists the database to disk and removes it from memory. The .tvdb file is preserved and can be re-loaded with POST /api/databases/load. Pass `?async=true` to run in the background.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: If true, returns 202 with a task ID instead of blocking

400.description: Cannot unload (last database, active database, or has aliases)

get.description: Lists all .tvdb files in the server's data directory, with their sizes and loaded status.
Downloads a .tvdb file from the data directory. If the database is loaded, it is persisted to disk first.

put.description: Uploads a .tvdb file to the data directory. Validates TVDB magic bytes. The file is NOT automatically loaded into memory - use POST /api/databases/load afterwards. Rejects if a file with the same name already exists.

400.description: Invalid TVDB file or file already exists

delete.description: Deletes a .tvdb file from the data directory. Rejects if the database is currently loaded (unload or drop it first).

get.description: Returns server status, uptime, memory usage and database stats. Public endpoint - no API key required.

post.description: Execute multiple Cypher statements separated by semicolons. Useful for bulk data import.
Import nodes from CSV data. Supports up to 512 MB request bodies.
Import edges from CSV data by matching source/target nodes via label+property lookup. Supports up to 512 MB request bodies.
Execute a Cypher query against the specified database. Returns columns, rows, query type, stats, and execution time. Results are capped at 1000 rows.

400.description: Missing query field or syntax error

get.description: Returns {"status": "ready"}. Public endpoint - no API key required.

post.description: Saves all in-memory databases to their .tvdb files immediately. Pass `?async=true` to run in the background and receive a task ID for polling.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: If true, returns 202 with a task ID instead of blocking

get.description: Returns labels, relationship types, property keys, and indexes for the specified database.
Returns node and edge visualization styles for the graph canvas.
Returns the current status of an async task. Poll this endpoint after receiving a 202 response with a task ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Task ID returned in the 202 response

put.description: Update a user's password and/or role.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint using JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP. Send `initialize`, then call tools via `tools/call`. Available tools: query, schema, databases, search_nodes, shortest_path, neighbors.

method.description: JSON-RPC method: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping

get.description: Upgrade to a WebSocket connection for real-time Bolt-style query execution. Used by Studio for live query sessions. Pass API key as `token` query parameter.
Returns metrics in Prometheus exposition format. Public endpoint - no API key required.
